title: Numerical Methods for Dynamical Low-Rank Approximations of Stochastic Differential Equations -- Part II: Stochastic discretization
summary: This paper is the follow up (Part II) of arXiv:2601.21428, which proposed and analyzed time discretization schemes for the Dynamical Low-Rank Approximation (DLRA) of high-dimensional systems of Stochastic Differential Equations (SDEs). In this work, we discuss and analyze the corresponding stochastic discretization. Specifically, we consider Monte Carlo type methods to approximate the stochastic space and all related quantities of interest, leading to produce noisy interacting particle systems whose error analysis is non standard.
